body.purpose: All Korean prose and display copy.

data-label.purpose: HILGRAM, English labels, indices, and measurements only.

breakpoints.name: tight-desktop
breakpoints.behavior: Portrait begins at 36% with a 7rem caption column; copy and switch become 38%; cover title becomes 11vw; identity becomes three columns; trait and case proportions tighten.

breakpoints.name: mobile-stack
breakpoints.behavior: Header becomes 54px; descriptor hides; cover orders portrait, copy, switch; index stays horizontal; spreads and ledgers stack; section gutters become 1.15rem; case, summary, belief, and footer become one column.

breakpoints.name: compact
breakpoints.behavior: Status icon and tab helper hide; portrait caption and transfer links stack; identity term column narrows to 5.5rem.

motion.name: skip-link
motion.purpose: Reveal the skip link on focus.

motion.name: sew-thread
motion.purpose: Initial thread draw when motion is allowed.

motion.name: local-rise
motion.purpose: First child of the newly keyed profile.

motion.name: root-view-transition
motion.purpose: Diagonal lining-out/lining-in mode change; disabled for reduced motion.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: One-iteration global animation and transition fallback.

viewTransition.guard: startViewTransition support and no prefers-reduced-motion: reduce

reducedPreferences.prefers-reduced-motion: Smooth scroll becomes auto; all animation/transition durations become .01ms with one iteration; root view-transition animation is none.

print.behavior: Force white/black output; cover breaks after; portrait is 34rem; sections avoid breaks with 2rem block padding; print-mode and full history show; dark pseudo-elements hide; dark headings become #111.

accessibility: Skip link targets #profile-panel and .sr-status announces mode changes politely.
ModeSwitch is a tablist with public-tab and secret-tab, aria-selected, aria-controls, roving tabIndex, and ArrowLeft/ArrowRight/Home/End keyboard selection.
Header .mode-status exposes a changing aria-label and aria-pressed.
#profile-panel is a focusable tabpanel labelled by the selected tab.
Contradictions expose table/row/columnheader/cell roles and retain del claims beside facts.
Headings label sections; identity and measures are labelled dl structures; history is native details/summary.
Portrait has descriptive alt text and adjacent usage/source caption; decorative SVG and marks are aria-hidden.
Links, buttons, summaries, and tabindex targets receive a 3px var(--thread) focus outline offset 4px.
Primary controls retain 44px or larger touch targets; mode tabs are 64px desktop and 58px mobile.

urlContract.initialization: app/page.tsx maps record=sealed to initialMode=secret; all other values are public.
urlContract.mutation: history.replaceState preserves pathname, other search parameters, and hash; public removes only record.
urlContract.deepScroll: After a mode change beyond .85 viewport height, #profile-panel scrolls into view.

browserChrome.synchronization: Each mode effect updates html[data-record] and every existing meta[name=theme-color].

hardRules: Public is the finished couture outside; secret is the exposed wrong-side lining of the same garment.
One carmine thread is the only accent family.
The interrogation, dossier, transit, route, rail, dashboard, and card-grid system is abolished.
Information and controls stay square; only literal thread knots and loops use rounded forms.
Keep exactly 3 contradiction rows and 7 choice items with their anchors and semantics.
Keep the Picrew usage and source caption adjacent to the portrait.
Preserve all fluid type endpoints and the exact 1100px, 760px, and 380px breakpoints.
Preserve focus, keyboard tabs, reduced motion/transparency, URL state, and print output.

components.name: Header Mode Status
components.description: Square 44px-minimum outside/lining toggle with a seam-shaped status mark.
components.css: .ds-mode-status { min-width: 9rem; min-height: 44px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1rem; padding: .55rem .75rem; border: 0; border-left: 1px solid var(--strong-rule); border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--ink); font: 700 .75rem/1 var(--data-font); letter-spacing: .12em; cursor: pointer; } .ds-mode-status i { width: 2rem; height: 7px; border-top: 1px dashed currentColor; } .ds-mode-status:hover { color: var(--thread); } .ds-mode-status:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--thread); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Outside / Lining Tabs
components.description: Two accessible tabs joined by hard rules and selected with one carmine seam.
components.css: .ds-mode-switch { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; border-block: 1px solid var(--strong-rule); } .ds-mode-switch button { position: relative; min-height: 64px; padding: .7rem 1rem; border: 0; border-right: 1px solid var(--rule); border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--muted); text-align: left; } .ds-mode-switch button:last-child { border-right: 0; } .ds-mode-switch button[aria-selected="true"] { color: var(--ink); box-shadow: inset 0 -4px var(--thread); } .ds-mode-switch small { display: block; margin-top: .15rem; font-size: .75rem; } .ds-mode-switch button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--thread); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Stitch Index
components.description: Flat horizontal anchored index strip; explicitly not a transit rail.
components.html:
INDEX / OUTSIDE

01신원02외관
components.css: .ds-stitch-index { display: flex; border-block: 1px solid var(--strong-rule); background: var(--ground); } .ds-stitch-index p { margin: 0; min-width: 10rem; padding: .9rem 1.2rem; border-right: 1px solid var(--strong-rule); color: var(--muted); font: 650 .75rem/1 var(--data-font); letter-spacing: .12em; } .ds-stitch-index a { min-width: 6rem; min-height: 48px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: .45rem; padding: .55rem .8rem; border-right: 1px dashed var(--rule); color: var(--ink); text-decoration: none; } .ds-stitch-index a:hover, .ds-stitch-index a span { color: var(--thread); } .ds-stitch-index a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--thread); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Identity Pattern
components.description: Five hard-edged measurements staggered across a diagonal cutting guide.
components.css: .ds-identity-pattern { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.55fr repeat(2, 1fr); gap: 1px; padding: 2.5rem 0 3rem; background: linear-gradient(174deg, transparent calc(50% - 1px), var(--strong-rule) 50%, transparent calc(50% + 1px)); } .ds-identity-pattern div { padding: clamp(1rem, 2.5vw, 2rem); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--paper) 82%, transparent); } .ds-identity-pattern dt { color: var(--muted); font-size: .75rem; } .ds-identity-pattern dd { margin: 1.2rem 0 0; font-size: clamp(1rem, 1.7vw, 1.4rem); font-weight: 760; }

components.name: False Seam Comparison
components.description: One of exactly three public claims unpicked beside its verified fact.
components.html:
01
공개 진술날붙이를 싫어한다
확인된 기록

살해 도구와 자해를 직접 선택했다.
components.css: .ds-false-seam { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 5rem 1.05fr .95fr; align-items: center; gap: 2rem; min-height: 18rem; border-top: 1px solid var(--strong-rule); color: var(--ink); } .ds-false-seam > b { color: var(--thread-soft); font: 700 clamp(4rem, 8vw, 8rem)/1 var(--data-font); } .ds-false-seam small { display: block; margin-bottom: 1rem; color: var(--thread); font-size: .75rem; font-weight: 750; } .ds-false-seam del { display: block; color: var(--muted); font-size: clamp(2rem, 4.8vw, 5.2rem); font-weight: 850; line-height: 1.08; text-decoration-color: var(--thread); text-decoration-thickness: 5px; } .ds-false-seam p { max-width: 33ch; margin: 0; line-height: 1.8; }

components.name: Deliberate Choice
components.description: One of exactly seven alternating cuts, with an oversized faded number and double-thread edge.
components.css: .ds-choice { position: relative; min-height: 24rem; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr minmax(18rem, 34rem); align-items: center; overflow: hidden; border-top: 1px dashed var(--rule); color: var(--ink); } .ds-choice > b { position: absolute; color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--thread) 18%, transparent); font: 800 clamp(10rem, 29vw, 29rem)/.8 var(--data-font); } .ds-choice > div { position: relative; grid-column: 2; padding: 2rem; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ground) 88%, transparent); border-left: 5px double var(--thread); } .ds-choice small { color: var(--thread); font: 650 .75rem/1 var(--data-font); letter-spacing: .12em; } .ds-choice h3 { margin: .8rem 0 1.2rem; font-size: clamp(1.7rem, 3vw, 2.8rem); } .ds-choice p { margin: 0; color: var(--muted); line-height: 1.9; }

components.name: Truth Seam
components.description: Secret-only correction set against a doubled carmine seam allowance.
components.html:
FALSE SEAM

공개 프로필의 설명은 피해자처럼 보이기 위한 연기다.
components.css: .ds-truth-seam { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(8rem, 1fr) minmax(0, 3fr); gap: 2rem; padding: 2rem 0 2rem 2rem; border-left: 6px double var(--thread); color: var(--ink); } .ds-truth-seam strong { color: var(--thread); font: 700 .8rem/1 var(--data-font); letter-spacing: .12em; } .ds-truth-seam p { max-width: 58ch; margin: 0; font-weight: 670; }

components.name: History Disclosure
components.description: Native closed details whose plus becomes a line; the full content is forced visible in print.
components.html:
과거사 전문 펼치기

과거사 전문이 이어진다.
components.css: .ds-history { border-top: 1px solid var(--strong-rule); color: var(--ink); } .ds-history summary { min-height: 6rem; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--strong-rule); cursor: pointer; font-weight: 760; } .ds-history summary i { position: relative; width: 2rem; height: 2rem; } .ds-history summary i::before, .ds-history summary i::after { position: absolute; top: 50%; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 2px; background: var(--thread); content: ""; transition: transform 220ms ease; } .ds-history summary i::after { transform: rotate(90deg); } .ds-history[open] summary i::after { transform: rotate(0); } .ds-history summary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--thread); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-history p { color: var(--muted); line-height: 2; }

narrative.northStar: PROMISE, WRONG SIDE OUT / 약속의 안감
narrative.overview: The public view is the finished outside of a couture garment: cold paper, controlled measurements, an irregular portrait cutout, and edition-scale type. The secret view turns the same promise wrong-side-out: near-black lining, exposed seam allowance, three unpicked false seams, seven deliberate cuts, and one carmine thread that tightens into a knot. The prior interrogation, dossier, transit-map, card-grid, rail, and dashboard system is abolished.
keyCharacteristics: Finished paper outside; exposed dark lining inside.
One carmine thread carries selection, focus, seams, warnings, and narrative continuity.
High asymmetry, irregular pattern-cut polygons, oversized edition type, and generous reading space.
Exactly three false seams and seven deliberate cuts remain factual counts.
The Picrew portrait is cut like fabric and keeps its usage caption adjacent.

rules.name: Wrong-Side-Out
rules.body: Every state change must feel like the same garment turning over; a palette swap alone is insufficient.

rules.name: One Thread
rules.body: Carmine is the sole accent family; never introduce a second accent or revive the former violet evidence palette.

rules.name: Two Hands
rules.body: Noto tells the story; Barlow marks the pattern. Never set Korean prose in Barlow Condensed.

rules.name: Flat Fabric
rules.body: A surface may overlap, cut, or expose its lining; it never floats like a card.

dos: Do treat public and secret as the finished outside and exposed lining of one couture object.
Do preserve the single carmine thread, square information surfaces, irregular cut shapes, and double-seam grammar.
Do keep exactly three contradiction rows and seven choice items, with their anchors and accessible labels.
Do keep the Picrew usage/source caption adjacent and preserve focus, tab keyboard behavior, reduced preferences, URL state, and print output.
Do preserve every fluid type endpoint and the exact 1100/760/380 responsive contract.
donts: Don't restore interrogation rooms, dossiers, evidence boards, transit maps, routes, rails, dashboards, card grids, or ornamental stamps.
Don't add rounded cards, pills, chips, glass, blur, shadows, or a competing accent; thread loops are the only rounded forms.
Don't convert .stitch-index into a navigation rail or .choice-seam into a route diagram.
Don't use Barlow Condensed for Korean prose or flatten the public/secret transition into a color-only theme toggle.
Don't remove contradiction facts, source limitations, content warning, accessible state, reduced-preference fallbacks, or print reveal.
